prompt: You are integrating Claude Code into your Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline. The system runs automated code reviews, generates test cases, and provides feedback on pull requests. You need to design prompts that provide actionable feedback and minimize false positives. The automated review consistently flags patterns your team uses intentionally—force-unwrapping optionals in test files, using large coordinator classes that follow your established architecture, and importing internally maintained modules marked as deprecated in the public SDK. Developers dismiss approximately 30% of all findings as project-specific false positives. Which approach prevents the model from generating these findings in the first place by supplying the project’s conventions as persistent context during every review?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Document the team’s accepted patterns and intentional conventions in the project’s CLAUDE.md file so the model receives this context during every review.
choices.textZh: 把团队认可的模式和有意采用的约定记录在项目的 CLAUDE.md 中，让模型在每次审查时都获得这些上下文。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure the review to analyze only the changed lines in the diff without the surrounding file context, reducing the amount of code the model evaluates.
choices.textZh: 让审查只分析差异中的改动行，不查看周围文件上下文，从而减少模型评估的代码量。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Build post-processing keyword filters that suppress findings containing terms such as “force unwrap,” “large class,” or “deprecated import” before results reach developers.
choices.textZh: 建立后处理关键词过滤器，在结果到达开发者之前，屏蔽包含“force unwrap”“large class”或“deprecated import”等词的发现。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Have developers add inline suppression comments at flagged lines and preprocess diffs to exclude suppressed lines before sending code to the model.
choices.textZh: 让开发者在被标记的代码行添加行内抑制注释，并在把差异发给模型前排除这些行。

categoryZh: Claude Code 配置与工作流
promptZh: 你正在将 Claude Code 集成到持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）流水线中。系统会自动审查代码、生成测试用例，并针对拉取请求提供反馈。你需要设计既能给出可执行建议、又能尽量减少误报的提示词。自动审查总是把团队有意采用的模式标为问题，例如测试文件中强制解包可选值、符合既定架构的大型协调器类，以及公共 SDK 虽标记弃用但内部仍维护的模块。开发者认为约 30% 的发现都是项目特有的误报。哪种做法能把项目约定作为每次审查都会获得的持久上下文，从源头避免模型生成这些发现？

prompt: You are building a multi-agent research system using the Claude Agent SDK. A coordinator agent delegates to specialized subagents: one searches the web, one analyzes documents, one synthesizes findings, and one generates reports. The system researches topics and produces comprehensive, cited reports. A user expands the research system beyond its original web-search agent by adding specialized data sources. A financial API agent returns structured JSON containing revenue, margins, and growth rates. A news-monitoring agent returns prose summaries of recent developments. A patent-analysis agent returns structured lists of technology areas. The synthesis agent combines these results into executive briefings. Currently, it converts everything into bullet points, causing financial comparisons to lose tabular clarity and news summaries to lose their narrative flow. What change would most improve briefing quality?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Standardize all subagent outputs as prose summaries with inline citations.
choices.textZh: 把所有子智能体的输出统一成带行内引用的散文摘要。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Add a format-conversion layer that transforms every subagent output into a common intermediate representation.
choices.textZh: 增加格式转换层，把每个子智能体的输出都转换成统一的中间表示。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Update the synthesis agent to render each content type appropriately—for example, financial data as tables, news as prose, and patent areas as structured lists.
choices.textZh: 让综合智能体根据内容类型选择合适的呈现方式，例如财务数据用表格、新闻用连贯文字、专利领域用结构化列表。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Standardize all subagent outputs as JSON containing claim, evidence, source, and confidence fields.
choices.textZh: 把所有子智能体的输出统一成包含 claim、evidence、source 和 confidence 字段的 JSON。

prompt: You are building a structured data extraction system using Claude. The system extracts information from unstructured documents, validates the output using JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) schemas, and maintains high accuracy. It must handle edge cases gracefully and integrate with downstream systems. Your system must extract event details from calendar invitations and output JSON that strictly conforms to a schema with fields for title, date, time, location, and attendees. Downstream systems reject any malformed or non-conformant JSON. What approach provides the most reliable schema compliance?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Pre-fill Claude’s response with an opening brace to force JSON output, then complete and parse the response.
choices.textZh: 预填一个左花括号，迫使 Claude 以 JSON 开头，再补全并解析响应。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Append instructions like “Output only valid JSON matching the schema exactly” and implement retry logic to re-prompt when JSON parsing fails.
choices.textZh: 追加“只输出完全匹配 Schema 的有效 JSON”等指令，并在解析失败时重试。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Define a tool with your target schema as input parameters and have Claude call it with the extracted data.
choices.textZh: 定义一个输入参数正好采用目标 Schema 的工具，让 Claude 用提取出的数据调用该工具。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Include detailed JSON formatting instructions and the target schema in your prompt, then parse Claude’s text response as JSON.
choices.textZh: 在提示词中加入详细 JSON 格式要求和目标 Schema，然后把 Claude 的文本响应作为 JSON 解析。

prompt: You have configured the system so that all four subagents have access to the complete set of 18 tools. During testing, agents frequently call tools outside their specialization—the synthesis agent attempts web searches, and the report generator tries to analyze documents. What is the primary cause of this poor tool-selection behavior?

choices.text: The agents’ role descriptions in their system prompts conflict with having access to tools outside those roles.
choices.textZh: 系统提示词为智能体定义的角色，与其获准使用的角色外工具相冲突。

choices.label: B
choices.text: The tool definitions consume too much context-window space, leaving insufficient room for task content.
choices.textZh: 工具定义占用了过多上下文窗口，留给任务内容的空间不足。

choices.label: C
choices.text: The coordinator cannot track which capabilities each subagent has, leading to misrouted tasks.
choices.textZh: 协调智能体无法追踪每个子智能体有哪些能力，因而把任务分派错了。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Choosing from 18 tools instead of four or five relevant tools increases decision complexity beyond reliable selection thresholds.
choices.textZh: 从 18 个工具而不是四五个相关工具中选择，使决策复杂度超过了可靠选择的阈值。

choices.textZh: 把两个子智能体都从 Sonnet 换成 Haiku，以缩短各自执行时间。

choices.label: B

choices.textZh: 在提示词中说明并行的性能优势，并要求协调智能体同时调用两个子智能体。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Create an asynchronous orchestration layer that starts separate coordinator-subagent pairs in parallel and aggregates their results.
choices.textZh: 建立异步编排层，并行启动两组独立的协调智能体与子智能体，再汇总结果。

prompt: You are building developer productivity tools using the Claude Agent SDK. An engineer asks your agent to identify untested code paths in a legacy payment processing module spanning 45 files. After reading the first 8 source files, the agent’s responses are becoming noticeably less accurate—it’s forgetting previously discussed code patterns and hasn’t yet located all test files or traced critical payment flows. prompt: You are building a structured data extraction system using Claude. Human reviewers have the capacity to check only 20% of extractions. Which approach most effectively allocates reviewer attention?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Have the model output field-level confidence scores, and then calibrate review thresholds using a labeled validation set.
choices.textZh: 让模型输出字段级置信度，并用带标签的验证集校准审核阈值。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Review all extractions from documents with formatting anomalies, such as unusual layouts or mixed content types.
choices.textZh: 审核所有版式异常或包含混合内容的文档。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Randomly sample 20% of extractions for review, using corrections to track accuracy and identify error patterns.
choices.textZh: 随机抽查 20%，用修正结果追踪准确率并识别错误模式。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Prioritize the review of all extractions where required fields are empty or explicitly marked as not found.
choices.textZh: 优先审核必填字段为空或明确标为未找到的全部结果。

What is the most effective way to improve subagent adaptability?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Specify research objectives and quality criteria—such as coverage breadth, source diversity, and recency—rather than prescribing procedural steps, allowing the subagent to determine its search strategy.
choices.textZh: 规定研究目标和质量标准，例如覆盖广度、来源多样性和时效性，而不规定操作步骤，让子智能体自行选择搜索策略。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Remove procedural details entirely and delegate using simple goals such as “research this topic thoroughly,” relying on the subagent’s general capabilities.
choices.textZh: 完全删除过程细节，只委派“彻底研究此主题”之类的简单目标，依赖子智能体的通用能力。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Add fallback directives requiring alternative query formulations whenever the specified searches produce fewer than a predetermined number of results.
choices.textZh: 增加后备指令：当指定搜索少于预定结果数时，必须改写查询。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Classify each topic as either “well-defined” or “exploratory” and use a different instruction style for each category.
choices.textZh: 先把主题分成“定义明确”和“探索性”两类，再分别采用不同指令风格。

prompt: You are integrating Claude Code into your Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline. The system runs automated code reviews, generates test cases, and provides feedback on pull requests. You need to design prompts that provide actionable feedback and minimize false positives. Your automated reviewer uses a single prompt covering security issues, API design, and business-logic correctness. Your evaluation suite shows strong recall for API-design findings at 82% but poor recall for business-logic edge cases in quiz scoring at 34%. When you add few-shot examples of logic bugs to the prompt, logic recall improves to 41%, but API-design recall drops to 68%. How should you address this trade-off to improve detection across both categories?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Split the review into separate focused prompts—one for security and API design and another for business logic—each with dedicated examples, and then consolidate the findings before posting.
choices.textZh: 拆成聚焦提示：一套检查安全与 API 设计，一套检查业务逻辑，各配专用示例，最后合并发现。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Replace the few-shot examples with a detailed checklist of specific logic edge cases to verify, such as division by zero in score calculations and boundary conditions in grading thresholds.
choices.textZh: 用除零、评分阈值等详细边界清单替换示例。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Upgrade to a more capable model tier because its stronger reasoning will handle both concern types in one prompt and eliminate the recall trade-off.
choices.textZh: 升级更强模型，让一个提示解决全部关注点。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Provide the full repository as context instead of only the changed files and surrounding code, giving the model deeper visibility into business-logic patterns.
choices.textZh: 把完整仓库而非改动文件和周边代码作为上下文。

prompt: A developer uses Claude Code to refactor a function during a development session. Before committing, the developer asks the same Claude session to review the code for issues. Later, a separate automated CI review catches several bugs that the same-session review missed. What best explains this discrepancy?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Claude retains context about its prior reasoning in the session, making it less likely to question its own decisions.
choices.textZh: Claude 保留了先前推理上下文，因此较不容易质疑自己的决定。

choices.label: B
choices.text: The CI review uses a more specific prompt tailored to catching bugs, while the developer’s request was too general.
choices.textZh: CI 使用了更具体的查错提示，而本地请求太泛。

choices.label: C
choices.text: The CI environment has access to the complete codebase, while the local session can see only the current file.
choices.textZh: CI 可访问完整代码库，本地会话只能看当前文件。

choices.label: D
choices.text: The extended session caused the context window to fill with conversation history, leaving insufficient capacity for thorough analysis.
choices.textZh: 长会话已填满上下文，无法深入分析。

prompt: The web-search agent has gathered several relevant sources for a research topic. The document-analysis agent now needs to examine those sources. How does information typically flow between these two specialized subagents?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The coordinator receives the web-search agent’s output and includes the relevant sources and findings in the prompt used to invoke the document-analysis agent.
choices.textZh: 协调智能体接收搜索输出，再把相关来源和发现放进调用文档分析智能体的提示中。

choices.label: B
choices.text: The web-search agent directly invokes the document-analysis agent and passes the discovered sources as parameters.
choices.textZh: 网页搜索智能体直接调用文档分析智能体，并把来源作为参数。

choices.label: C
choices.text: The agents communicate through an event-driven message queue, with the document-analysis agent subscribing to web-search completion events.
choices.textZh: 两者通过事件消息队列通信，文档分析订阅搜索完成事件。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both agents automatically access a shared memory store in which the web-search agent writes its findings.
choices.textZh: 两者自动访问共享记忆库，搜索智能体把发现写进去。

prompt: You are building a multi-agent research system using the Claude Agent SDK. A coordinator agent delegates to specialized subagents: one searches the web, one analyzes documents, one synthesizes findings, and one generates reports. The system researches topics and produces comprehensive, cited reports. The document-analysis agent has a single analyze_document tool that takes a document and a free-text instruction parameter. During evaluation, requests such as “extract the key financial metrics” often return narrative summaries, while “summarize the methodology” sometimes returns raw data tables. The synthesis agent reports that 35% of analysis results require new requests with clarified instructions. What is the most effective way to improve reliability?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Enhance the tool description with detailed examples showing how different instruction phrasings should map to different output formats.
choices.textZh: 扩展工具描述，用示例说明各种措辞应映射到何种格式。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Split the generic tool into purpose-specific tools—extract_data_points, summarize_content, and verify_claim_against_source—each with defined input and output contracts.
choices.textZh: 拆成 extract_data_points、summarize_content、verify_claim_against_source 等用途明确、输入输出契约清晰的工具。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Keep the single tool but add an analysis_type enum parameter requiring explicit selection between extraction, summarization, and verification modes.
choices.textZh: 保留单一工具，增加 extraction、summary、verification 的 analysis_type 枚举。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Have the coordinator pre-classify each analysis request before passing instructions to the document-analysis agent.
choices.textZh: 让协调智能体预先分类每个分析请求。

categoryZh: 工具设计与 MCP 集成
promptZh: 你正在使用 Claude Agent SDK 构建多智能体研究系统。协调智能体把任务分派给多个专用子智能体：一个搜索网页，一个分析文档，一个综合研究发现，另一个生成报告。系统需要研究指定主题，并产出内容全面且带引用的报告。文档分析智能体只有一个 analyze_document 工具，接收文档和自由文本指令。“提取财务指标”常得到叙述摘要，“总结方法”有时得到原始表格，35% 结果需要重发澄清。怎样提高可靠性最有效？

prompt: You are building developer productivity tools using the Claude Agent SDK. The agent helps engineers explore unfamiliar codebases, understand legacy systems, generate boilerplate code, and automate repetitive tasks. It uses the built-in tools (Read, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob) and integrates with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Your codebase exploration tool stores session IDs to allow engineers to continue investigations across work sessions. An engineer spent an hour yesterday analyzing a legacy authentication module, building context about its architecture and dependencies. They want to continue today. The session ID is valid, but version control shows 3 of the 12 files the agent previously read were modified overnight by a teammate’s merge. What approach best balances efficiency and accuracy?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Start a fresh session to ensure the agent works with current codebase state without stale assumptions
choices.textZh: 新开会话，确保完全没有陈旧假设。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Resume the session and inform the agent which specific files changed for targeted re-analysis
choices.textZh: 恢复会话，并告诉智能体具体哪三个文件发生变化，让它定向重新分析。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Resume the session and immediately have the agent re-read all 12 previously analyzed files
choices.textZh: 恢复后立即重新读取全部 12 个文件。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Resume the session without informing the agent about the changed files
choices.textZh: 直接恢复，不告知文件变化。

promptZh: 你正在使用 Claude Agent SDK 构建开发者效率工具。该智能体帮助工程师探索陌生代码库、理解遗留系统、生成样板代码并自动处理重复任务。它会使用 Read、Write、Bash、Grep 和 Glob 等内置工具，也会连接模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器。代码探索工具保存 session ID，工程师昨天用一小时分析遗留认证模块。今天要继续时，ID 仍有效，但版本控制显示先前读取的 12 个文件中有 3 个被队友修改。怎样兼顾效率和准确性？

prompt: After deploying the automated review, you notice high precision but low recall—real bugs are slipping through undetected. Investigation reveals that your review prompt instructs Claude to “only report high-confidence issues you are certain about” and “err on the side of not commenting.” Developers appreciate the low noise, but a race condition that caused a production outage was visible in a reviewed pull request and went unreported. You need to substantially improve bug detection while keeping false-positive rates manageable. What is the most effective approach?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Add detailed few-shot examples demonstrating bug categories Claude should flag—race conditions, null dereferences, and error-handling gaps—while retaining the high-confidence filtering instruction.
choices.textZh: 保留高置信过滤，只增加竞态、空指针和错误处理缺口等示例。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Remove the conservative instructions and have Claude report every potential issue, then apply a programmatic filter that deduplicates findings and suppresses historically noisy categories.
choices.textZh: 删除保守指令，让 Claude 报告每个可能问题，再用程序去重并屏蔽历史噪声类别。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Split the review into a finding stage whose objective is comprehensive coverage—reporting every potential issue with confidence and severity metadata—and a separate stage that verifies and thresholds those findings.
choices.textZh: 拆成两个阶段：发现阶段追求完整覆盖并给每项附置信度与严重度；验证阶段独立核实并设阈值。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Expand the context to include related tests, recent Git history, and the module’s dependency graph so Claude has richer evidence for judging severity.
choices.textZh: 增加相关测试、Git 历史和依赖图上下文，给模型更多判断严重度的证据。

prompt: When researching “renewable-energy adoption,” the web-search agent returns recent statistics showing 35% adoption in 2024, while the document-analysis agent extracts an 18% adoption figure from an internal 2021 report. The synthesis agent incorrectly treats the figures as contradictory instead of recognizing that they may show growth over time. What change would best enable the synthesis agent to interpret such temporal differences correctly?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Require subagents to include publication dates and data-collection periods in their structured outputs.
choices.textZh: 要求子智能体在结构化输出中包含发布日期和数据采集期间。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Configure the web-search agent to return only results published during the previous six months.
choices.textZh: 网页搜索只返回最近六个月发布的结果。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Add a conflict-resolution agent that automatically discards older data whenever a newer value exists for the same metric.
choices.textZh: 增加冲突解决智能体，同一指标有新数据就丢弃旧数据。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Instruct the synthesis agent to treat the newest value as authoritative and place all older findings in a separate historical section.
choices.textZh: 要求综合智能体把最新值当权威，旧值统一放历史章节。

prompt: You are using Claude Code to accelerate software development. Your team uses it for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and documentation. You need to integrate it into your development workflow with custom slash commands, CLAUDE.md configurations, and understand when to use plan mode vs direct execution. Your infrastructure-as-code repository includes Terraform modules (/terraform/), Kubernetes manifests (/kubernetes/), and CI/CD pipeline scripts (/pipelines/). Each requires different conventions, but your single root CLAUDE.md has grown to 500+ lines. When developers work on Kubernetes files, Terraform-specific rules load into context unnecessarily, consuming tokens. What is the best approach to reorganize so only relevant guidance loads when editing specific file types?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Create files in .claude/rules/ with YAML frontmatter path-scoping (e.g., paths: [ " terraform/**/*.tf " ]), loading rules only when editing matching files.
choices.textZh: 在 .claude/rules/ 中创建带 YAML frontmatter `paths` 范围的规则，例如只匹配 `terraform/**/*.tf`。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Restructure the root CLAUDE.md into clearly labeled sections with headers (e.g., “## Terraform Conventions”), improving organization and readability.
choices.textZh: 只在根 CLAUDE.md 用标题分成 Terraform、Kubernetes 等章节。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Split content into subdirectory CLAUDE.md files (/terraform/CLAUDE.md, /kubernetes/CLAUDE. md), so Claude loads directory-specific guidance.
choices.textZh: 分别在 /terraform/、/kubernetes/ 建 CLAUDE.md，让目录规则加载。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Keep the root CLAUDE.md and use @path/to/import syntax to modularly include tool-specific guidance files from separate documents.
choices.textZh: 根 CLAUDE.md 通过 @path/to/import 引入拆开的规则文件。

promptZh: 你正在使用 Claude Code 加速软件开发。团队用它生成代码、重构、调试和编写文档。你需要通过自定义斜杠命令和 CLAUDE.md 配置把它融入开发工作流，并理解何时应使用计划模式、何时应直接执行。基础设施即代码仓库包含 /terraform/、/kubernetes/ 和 /pipelines/，各有不同约定。单一根 CLAUDE.md 已超过 500 行；处理 Kubernetes 时，Terraform 规则也会无谓加载。怎样重组才能只在编辑匹配文件时加载相关指导？

prompt: You are building a customer support resolution agent using the Claude Agent SDK. The agent handles high-ambiguity requests like returns, billing disputes, and account issues. It has access to your backend systems through custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools (get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund, escalate_to_human). Your target is 80%+ first-contact resolution while knowing when to escalate. You’re implementing the escalation logic for when the agent should call escalate_to_human. Your team proposes four different approaches for triggering escalation. Which approach will most reliably identify cases that genuinely require human intervention?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Build a rules engine that maps specific issue types, customer segments, and product categories to escalation decisions, removing the need for model judgment calls.
choices.textZh: 建立规则引擎，把特定问题类型、客户群和产品类别映射到升级决定，完全去掉模型判断。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Instruct the agent to escalate when the customer requests a human, when the issue requires policy exceptions, or when the agent cannot make meaningful progress.
choices.textZh: 指示智能体在客户明确要求人工、问题需要政策例外，或已无法取得有意义进展时升级。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Configure the agent to escalate after three consecutive tool calls that fail to resolve the customer’s stated issue, ensuring a reasonable attempt before involving a human.
choices.textZh: 连续三次工具调用仍未解决问题后升级。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Implement sentiment analysis that monitors for frustration indicators (negative language, repeated questions, exclamation marks) and triggers escalation when the frustration score exceeds a configured threshold.
choices.textZh: 用情感分析监测负面语言、重复问题和感叹号，分数超过阈值就升级。

prompt: In production, final reports frequently contain claims without proper source attribution. Investigation shows that the web-search and document-analysis agents correctly attach citations to their outputs, but the synthesis agent loses track of which sources support which conclusions when combining findings. What is the most effective architectural change?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Add a verification step in which the report generator uses semantic-similarity matching against the original sources to reconstruct claim provenance.
choices.textZh: 让报告器用语义相似度回查原始来源，重建出处。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Have the coordinator insert source-identifier prefixes into prose before every handoff and parse those prefixes during report generation.
choices.textZh: 协调层在每次交接的散文前加来源 ID 前缀，报告阶段再解析。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Require every subagent to return structured claim-to-source mappings that the synthesis agent must preserve and merge when combining findings.
choices.textZh: 要求每个子智能体返回结构化的 claim-to-source 映射，综合时必须保留并合并。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Retain complete transcripts of every subagent interaction and add a citation-resolution agent that analyzes those logs before report generation.
choices.textZh: 保留所有子智能体完整转录，再加引用解析智能体读日志。

prompt: You are integrating Claude Code into your Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline. The system runs automated code reviews, generates test cases, and provides feedback on pull requests. You need to design prompts that provide actionable feedback and minimize false positives. Your automated review generates many findings per pull request, but developer feedback shows that approximately half are dismissed as “not worth addressing.” Analysis reveals that these findings are often technically accurate but involve minor style preferences or patterns that are acceptable in the project. Before adding infrastructure complexity, what prompt-design change would most effectively reduce dismissals while maintaining detection of genuine issues?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Add a secondary classification model that filters findings according to predicted developer acceptance.
choices.textZh: 增加预测开发者接受度的第二分类模型。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ask Claude to rate each finding’s confidence from 1 to 10 and include only findings rated 8 or higher.
choices.textZh: 让 Claude 给每项打 1–10 置信分，只保留不低于 8。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Define explicit reporting criteria that distinguish reportable bugs and security issues from minor style preferences and accepted local patterns.
choices.textZh: 明确报告标准，区分应报告的缺陷和安全问题，以及应跳过的风格偏好与项目认可模式。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Add the instruction: “Only report findings you are highly confident are genuine problems.”
choices.textZh: 要求“只报告高度确信的真实问题”。

prompt: Your automated review CI jobs take 18 seconds to initialize before Claude begins analyzing code. Profiling reveals that the delay comes from automatically discovering hooks, MCP servers, plugins, skills, and multiple nested CLAUDE.md files throughout your monorepo. You need to reduce startup time while ensuring that reviews still enforce your team’s coding standards, which are documented in the root-level CLAUDE.md file. What is the most effective approach?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Run in --bare mode and specify all review criteria directly in the -p prompt argument for every CI invocation, without referencing external files.
choices.textZh: 用 --bare，并把全部标准直接重复在每次 -p 参数中。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Replace the default prompt entirely by using --system-prompt-file ./CLAUDE.md, which bypasses default prompt assembly and loads only your project rules.
choices.textZh: 用 --system-prompt-file ./CLAUDE.md 完全替换默认提示。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Run in --bare mode and pass --append-system-prompt-file ./CLAUDE.md to explicitly load your project standards while skipping all automatic discovery.
choices.textZh: 用 --bare 跳过自动发现，再用 --append-system-prompt-file ./CLAUDE.md 明确加载项目规范。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Keep the default initialization and add --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections to reduce per-machine prompt variability and improve prompt-cache hit rates across runners.
choices.textZh: 保留初始化，增加 --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections 改善跨运行器缓存。

Which configuration approach correctly applies MCP server scopes?

choices.text: Add both servers to your local ~/.claude.json.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Use separate extraction calls for each field to ensure consistent handling of each type.
choices.textZh: 每个字段分别调用一次抽取，保证单独处理。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Define a strict output schema and include format normalization rules in your prompt.
choices.textZh: 定义严格输出 Schema，并在提示中要求格式规范化。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Request multiple extraction attempts per document and select the most common format.
choices.textZh: 每份文档多次抽取，选择最常见格式。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Extract data as-is and normalize formats in post-processing code after Claude returns.
choices.textZh: 让 Claude 按原文抽取，再由后处理代码确定性地规范价格和标签。

choices.label: D

choices.textZh: 接入现成的 Jira MCP 服务器，通过可发现工具提供工单、评论和元数据。

After the first week, usage.input_tokens averages about 3,900 per request. What is the most likely explanation?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Prompt caching is not enabled, so the system prompt is counted at full weight each time.
choices.textZh: 没有启用提示缓存，所以每次都按完整数量计算系统提示的 tokens。

choices.label: D
choices.text: The tool definition is sent with every request and counts toward input tokens.
choices.textZh: 每次请求都会发送工具定义，而工具定义也计入输入 tokens。

prompt: You are building a structured data extraction system using Claude. The system extracts information from unstructured documents, validates the output using JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) schemas, and maintains high accuracy. It must handle edge cases gracefully and integrate with downstream systems. Your extraction system exposes three tools: extract_fields, whose schema-validated JSON output is written to your database, plus lookup_vendor and flag_for_review, which support operator questions and edge cases. Every submitted document must produce an extract_fields record. In testing, when an operator submits a document with a request like "extract this invoice and check whether the vendor already exists," Claude sometimes calls only lookup_vendor and never calls extract_fields, so no record is written. Which approach guarantees an extract_fields call for every submitted document while still allowing Claude to handle the rest of the operator's request?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Set tool_choice to "auto" and reorder the tool definitions so extract_fields appears first in the tools array, since Claude prioritizes earlier-listed tools.
choices.textZh: 将 tool_choice 设为 "auto"，并把 extract_fields 放在 tools 数组首位，因为 Claude 会优先使用排在前面的工具。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Set tool_choice to {"type": "tool", "name": "extract_fields"} on the first request after submission, then return tool_choice to "auto" on subsequent turns so Claude can address the rest of the operator's request.
choices.textZh: 文档提交后的首次请求将 tool_choice 设为 {"type": "tool", "name": "extract_fields"}，后续轮次恢复为 "auto"，让 Claude 处理其余事项。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Set tool_choice to {"type": "tool", "name": "extract_fields"} for every API call in the pipeline, ensuring Claude always extracts fields before addressing the rest of the operator's request.
choices.textZh: 流水线中的每次 API 调用都将 tool_choice 设为 {"type": "tool", "name": "extract_fields"}，确保 Claude 始终先抽取字段再处理其他事项。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Set tool_choice to "any" so Claude must use a tool, combined with system prompt instructions prioritizing extract_fields.
choices.textZh: 将 tool_choice 设为 "any"，要求使用某个工具，并在系统提示中要求优先调用 extract_fields。

prompt: You are building a structured data extraction system using Claude. The current implementation prompts Claude to return JSON in the response text and then parses it. What is the most reliable approach to ensure Claude returns valid, schema-compliant structured data?

choices.text: Add explicit formatting instructions to the prompt with JSON examples, emphasizing that Claude must return only valid JSON with no surrounding text.
choices.textZh: 在提示中加入明确的格式说明和 JSON 示例，强调只能返回有效 JSON，不能有任何外围文本。

choices.label: B
choices.text: Implement a retry loop that catches JSON parse errors and re-prompts Claude with the error details, asking it to correct the malformed output.
choices.textZh: 捕获 JSON 解析错误后循环重试，把错误详情发给 Claude，要求修正格式错误的输出。

choices.label: C
choices.text: Use regular expressions to locate and extract JSON from the response text, handling cases where Claude includes explanatory text around the JSON block.
choices.textZh: 用正则表达式从响应文本中定位并提取 JSON，以处理 Claude 在 JSON 块前后附加解释文字的情况。

choices.label: D
choices.text: Define the expected structure as a JSON schema and provide it in output_config.format so the API constrains Claude's output to that structure.
choices.textZh: 用 JSON Schema 定义预期结构，并通过 output_config.format 提供给 API，在生成时约束 Claude 的输出结构。
